defects: Canopy is too small and asymmetrical relative to the approved target.
Roof supports do not connect into a continuous truss assembly.
hard_fail_reasons: The one-sided canopy does not read as the target's supported raised-ridge workshop roof.
incumbent_comparison: Compared with accepted v004 in matched Godot cameras, v007 removes the obstructive roof mass but replaces it with an undersized one-sided awning. The boiler remains visible, yet the canopy and truss read is weaker than v004's supported open central roof slot. Keep v004 as best 3D and production asset.
likely_causes: The first transfer strategy removed the full roof before fitting a compact awning over the bench.
Target canopy width and support connections were lost during geometry translation.
next_action_hypothesis: A future attempt would need a component-authored ridge canopy tied into a continuous support frame while leaving an open machine lane above the boiler; do not change RoomDefinition landmarks or boiler/gameplay positions.

observations.art_direction_fit: The machinery retains Clockwork identity, but the asymmetric workbench awning reads less like the selected workshop concept than accepted v004's continuous roof with a central machine opening.
observations.close_up_quality: The Godot detail view shows the roof supports ending beside the upper wall courses rather than forming the continuous truss-supported target assembly.
observations.gameplay_readability: The boiler and flywheel remain readable and the RoomDefinition landmark and citizen scale are unchanged.
observations.geometric_detail: Posts, board courses, boiler fittings, pressure line, flywheel, bench, and a raised roof assembly survive the transfer.
observations.material_realism: Timber, iron, copper, and stone remain separate under the normal production light.
observations.proportion: Godot validates a 25.5 x 20.46 x 19.25-inch envelope; the slight 0.46-inch depth overshoot remains within validator tolerance.
observations.scale_fidelity: The model remains near the 26 x 20 x 20-inch brief envelope and does not alter the settlement site.
observations.semantic_recognizability: The boiler, flywheel, flue, timber bays, and bench still read as a Clockwork workshop.
observations.silhouette_quality: The small one-sided canopy does not transfer the approved full raised-ridge roof silhouette as clearly as intended.
observations.surface_variation: Board courses and mixed metal/timber areas break up the structure, though the reduced canopy leaves the top sparse.
observations.technical_integration: Godot 4.7.2 Compatibility import and RoomScale production rendering pass with no fallback.

close_inspection.evidence: The Godot detail capture shows a disconnected canopy and unresolved support joins.

edge_treatment.evidence: The window retains stepped casing, fitted sash rails, and finished sill edges.

hardware.evidence: The second-pass latch sits on the camera-facing centre stile and appears at the meeting rail.

joins.evidence: The casing, transom, sash rails, centre stile, and sill remain separate fitted parts.

manufacturing_detail.evidence: Upper lights, meeting rail, and the central sash latch read as a constructed double-hung assembly.

material_response.evidence: Warm timber, visible outdoors through low-alpha glazing, and metal hardware have separate responses in the production scene.

surface_variation.evidence: The dark stained casing and lighter sash members remain distinguishable.

thickness.evidence: Casing and projecting sill hold physical depth in the Godot close capture.

neutral_viewer_realism.evidence: The production render identifies the intended built asset.

photo_character.evidence: No photographed source is attached to this ArtBrief; the approved target is the design reference.

visual_transfer_diagnosis.corrective_action: Preserve v004 and backlog this target for a component-authored canopy pass with a continuous load-bearing frame and open machine lane; do not accept the asymmetric v007 roof as a production replacement.
lost_visual_information: The broad, supported raised ridge roof from the approved target became a small one-sided canopy.
Continuous truss-to-post load paths are not readable in the close render.
preserved_components: Clockwork boiler, flywheel, gauge, and flue
